name: Sinkha: Hyleyn
source:
Hyleyn has now become involved with the immortal Sinkha, the most advanced life form in the universe. Through a series of dramatic circumstances, she is no longer wholly human — now she is also one of them... Together with her new Sinkha friends Aker and Darshine, Hyleyn embarks on an adventure to save a world from an encroaching invasion.

As an added bonus, Hyleyn includes an abridged version of [url=/v3836]Sinkha[/url] which contains fewer but enhanced (although static) CG artworks, as well as an expanded description of the original events.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sinkha]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
海琳如今已经与不死种族Sinkha产生了联系。Sinkha是宇宙中最高等的生命形态。经历一连串戏剧性事件后，她不再是纯粹的人类——如今她也成为了他们的一员…海琳与新结识的Sinkha朋友阿克和达希恩一同踏上冒险，拯救一个正遭入侵威胁的世界。

作为额外奖励，《Hyleyn》还收录了[url=/v3836]《Sinkha》[/url]的删节版本。该版本CG数量较少，但画面经过增强，尽管仍为静态图；同时也扩充了对原作事件的描述。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sinkha]Wikipedia[/url]]
